candidate_relations.reason: Dandy–Walker malformation is a congenital vermian/cystic fourth-ventricle anomaly, not multiple posterior-fossa cysts with a fourth-ventricle cyst.
Bilateral optic-disc edema is the raised-ICP manifestation of fourth-ventricle obstruction, not neurocysticercosis itself.
Multiple sclerosis does not produce multiple posterior-fossa cysts and obstructive hydrocephalus.
A generic brain tumor does not capture racemose/ventricular cysticercosis cysts causing hydrocephalus.
Papilledema is real, but ascribing it to brain tumor conflicts with cysticercosis as the cause of obstruction.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Papilledema attributed to tumor rather than NCC

candidate_relations.reason: Dandy–Walker syndrome is a different congenital posterior-fossa malformation from neurocysticercosis.
Optic neuritis is inflammatory optic neuropathy, not papilledema from obstructive hydrocephalus.
Tinnitus is a presenting symptom of raised pressure, not the parasitic diagnosis.
Cranial nerve disorder labels symptoms rather than neurocysticercosis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Nonspecific cranial-nerve framing of visual/auditory symptoms

candidate_relations.reason: Neurocysticercosis matches multiple posterior-fossa cysts including a large fourth-ventricle cyst causing obstructive hydrocephalus and papilledema.
A solitary arachnoid cyst is a different cystic entity from multiple posterior-fossa cysticerci.
Ménière disease is an inner-ear disorder and does not explain papilledema or ventricular cysts.
Hydrocephalus is the complication of the fourth-ventricle cyst, not the cysticercosis infection itself.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Obstructive hydrocephalus as the ICP mechanism

candidate_relations.reason: Idiopathic intracranial hypertension has no obstructive ventricular cyst; MRI shows a fourth-ventricle cyst with hydrocephalus.
CSF had no cells or organisms; this is ventricular cysticercosis, not acute meningitis.
Visual disturbance is the functional manifestation of disc edema, not neurocysticercosis.
Pseudotumor cerebri is IIH without a mass/cyst; this case has obstructive hydrocephalus from cysts.
Chiari malformation is a hindbrain herniation anomaly, not multiple posterior-fossa cysts.
A posterior-fossa arachnoid cyst is a single developmental cyst, incompatible with multiple cysticercosis cysts including an intraventricular lesion.
